hero.name: Cleyton Mendes
hero.title: Software Engineer
hero.tagline: I build e-commerce storefronts on VTEX, Shopify and Deco, with React and TypeScript.

about.title: About
about.p1: I am a Software Engineer in Rio de Janeiro and I have worked on e-commerce since 2021. I started on VTEX at ED3 Digital, building storefronts for brands such as Tiffany & Co., Hugo Boss, Creamy and Candide, then moved to Deco and Shopify integrations at We.digi. Today I work on the QuestEdu platform.
about.p2: I am studying Software Engineering at Estácio and I keep learning: my most recent courses cover NestJS, Next.js and Shopify theme development.
